_doc: Round 4 LOOKS: the numbers of the elements' looks (ToonFx.looks reads them; the shaders' uniforms are set from here by ToonFx.mat). Looks only: no hitbox, speed, damage or zone radius is here. near: every effect's pixels fade (a screen-door dither, no sorting) from far_m to near_alpha at near_m from the camera (nothing of your own fills your view). own_wall: your own walls and pillars between the camera and your head, or within near_m of the camera, dither to alpha (they still block everything); speed: how fast the fade moves (per s). own_guard: your own Wind Guard's bands drawn band_w as wide, seen from your own camera. range: a bolt's drawn core grows past from_m from the camera up to max times at full_m (its hitbox unchanged). flame: soft edges (soft, in the flame field's units), the domain warp, the tips' embers, the fade where flames meet the deck (deck_fade_m), the fireball's tongues (tongues, each its own phase), the fire wall's flames (count_mult as many at width_mult as wide), the glow underlay's strength; THE CEL LOOK (2026-10-16, fire as the show draws it): cel on, cel_fps the drawings a second its boil steps at, ink the outline on (whatever ToonFx.style), ink_w its width, lobes the tips a tongue splits into, notch how deep the V between them cuts, cel_noise the share of the noise kept. floor_wave: the Kick's three rows (crest, body, trail: their counts, depths behind the front (m) and heights as a share of the crest), fill (how much of a tongue's quad its flame fills: its visible top), the scorch every scorch_every_m fading over scorch_s, sparks thrown ahead, the embers that spill past the lip. smoke: Breath's smoke (a lit volume): its curl (rad over its life), its growth, its tints, its warm under-glow (warm_s from the flame), the deck fade. puffs: a hit's burst on a body stays within body_share of the body's height (body_h_m when it says none; a body within find_r_m of the hit); the puffs between the camera and the struck body drawn at half. air_dust: under an air bolt within over_m of the deck a thin line of dust rises, every every_s. shadow: each bolt's shadow-only core, as a share of its radius by kind.
